welcome_page.title: Welcome to Your Profile
welcome_page.description:
A few questions about you, your household and where you live.

Taking part is voluntary and you can skip any question, such as income. Your answers are not linked to your name. Giving your email is optional; the SmartUrbanity privacy notice explains how it is protected and how answers are used.

Learn more about SmartUrbanity

final_page.title: Thank you!
final_page.description: Your submission has been recorded. Thank you for taking the time to complete the questionnaire.

sections.title: About You
sections.description: A few questions about you and your household. They help us understand how easy it is for different people to get around and reach the places they need.

questions.text: What is your highest completed level of education?
questions.help: If you are still studying, choose the last level you completed. If you studied abroad, choose the closest equivalent.

questions.text: Which of the following best describes your relationship to Municipio XII?

options.text: I live here (even without official registered residence)
I travel here regularly for work or study (Commuter)
I come here regularly for services, healthcare or to accompany someone
I come here now and then (e.g. to study, work or see people)
I'm visiting or staying for a short time (e.g. tourism, family)

questions.text: In which neighbourhood or area of Municipio XII do you currently live?
questions.help: If you use another name (e.g. Gianicolense or Portuense), choose the closest official neighbourhood, or Other.

questions.text: How strongly do you feel connected to the people in your neighbourhood?
How many adults (aged 18 or older), including yourself, live in your home?
How many children (aged under 18) live in your home?
Do you regularly accompany or look after someone who needs your help to get around or in daily life? You can choose more than one answer.

options.text: Yes, I accompany children or teenagers almost every day (e.g. to school, sports or other activities)
Yes, I accompany children or teenagers at least once a week
Yes, I help an adult who lives with me (e.g. an older relative or a person with disabilities)
Yes, I help an adult who does not live with me

questions.text: Which of the following vehicles are available in your household?
Do you hold a valid driving license? (Car, motorcycle or both)

options.text: Yes, but I do not drive

questions.text: If there is a car in your household, how easy is it for you to use it when you need it?
Which of these best describe your current work or study situation? If you both study and work, you can choose two answers.

options.text: Work through an app or platform (e.g. delivery rider, ride-hailing driver)
Caring full-time for a family member

questions.text: Do you have flexible working hours (the ability to choose or adjust your start and finish times)?
Do you currently work remotely (partly or fully)?

options.text: Yes (3 days or more in a week)
Yes, occasionally (1-2 days in a week)

questions.text: Thinking about the income of everyone who lives with you, which of these best describes your household's economic situation?

options.text: We struggle to cover basic needs
We can cover basic needs comfortably and have little money left over
We can afford most things we want with occasional extra expenses
We are financially very comfortable and can easily afford extra expenses

questions.text: Do you have a disability, health condition or limitation, even a mild one, that makes getting around harder?
questions.help: For example with walking, sight, hearing, attention or pain, or if you use a wheelchair or another aid. We ask to understand which obstacles people meet.

it.#Welcome to Your Profile: Ti diamo il benvenuto nel questionario sul tuo profilo
it.#<p>A few questions about you, your hous:
Alcune domande su di te, sul tuo nucleo familiare e sul luogo in cui vivi.

La partecipazione è volontaria e puoi saltare qualsiasi domanda, per esempio quella sul reddito. Le tue risposte non sono collegate al tuo nome. Lasciare l'email è facoltativo; l'informativa sulla privacy di SmartUrbanity spiega come viene protetta e come vengono usate le risposte.

Scopri di più su SmartUrbanity
it.#<p>Your submission has been recorded. T: La tua risposta è stata registrata. Grazie per il tempo dedicato alla compilazione del questionario.
it.#If there is a car in your household, ho: Se nel tuo nucleo familiare c'è un'automobile, quanto è facile per te usarla quando ne hai bisogno?
it.#What is your age group?: Qual è la tua fascia d’età?
it.#What is your highest completed level of: Qual è il tuo titolo di studio più elevato tra quelli conseguiti?
it.#If you are still studying, choose the l: Se stai ancora studiando, indica l'ultimo titolo conseguito. Se hai studiato all'estero, scegli il titolo equivalente più vicino.
it.#Which of the following best describes y: Quale delle seguenti opzioni descrive meglio il tuo rapporto con il Municipio XII?
it.#I live here (even without official regi: Ci vivo (anche senza residenza ufficialmente registrata)
it.#I travel here regularly for work or stu: Vengo qui regolarmente per lavoro o studio (pendolare)
it.#I come here regularly for services, hea: Ci vengo regolarmente per servizi, assistenza sanitaria o per accompagnare qualcuno
it.#I come here now and then (e.g. to study: Vengo qui ogni tanto (ad es. per studio, lavoro o per incontrare persone)
it.#I'm visiting or staying for a short tim: Sono qui in visita o per un breve periodo (ad es. turismo, famiglia)
it.#How strongly do you feel connected to t: Quanto è forte il legame che senti con le persone del tuo quartiere?
it.#Neither connected nor disconnected: Un legame né forte né debole
it.#How many adults (aged 18 or older), inc: Quante persone adulte (di 18 anni o più) vivono nella tua casa, contando anche te?
it.#How many children (aged under 18) live: Quante persone con meno di 18 anni vivono nella tua casa?
it.#Do you regularly accompany or look afte: Accompagni o assisti regolarmente qualcuno che ha bisogno del tuo aiuto per spostarsi o nella vita quotidiana? Puoi scegliere più di una risposta.
it.#Yes, I accompany children or teenagers: Sì, accompagno bambine, bambini o adolescenti quasi ogni giorno (es. a scuola, sport o altre attività)
Sì, accompagno bambine, bambini o adolescenti almeno una volta alla settimana
it.#Yes, I help an adult who lives with me: Sì, aiuto una persona adulta che vive con me (es. una persona anziana della famiglia o una persona con disabilità)
it.#Yes, I help an adult who does not live: Sì, aiuto una persona adulta che non vive con me
it.#Which of the following vehicles are ava: Quali tra questi veicoli sono disponibili a casa tua?
it.#Powered wheelchair or mobility scooter: Sedia a rotelle motorizzata o scooter per la mobilità
it.#Do you hold a valid driving license? (C: Possiedi una patente di guida valida? (Auto, moto o entrambe)
it.#Which of these best describe your curre: Quale di queste descrive meglio la tua attuale situazione lavorativa o di studio? Se studi e lavori, puoi scegliere due risposte.
it.#Self-employed or freelance (full-time): Lavoro autonomo o libera professione (tempo pieno)
it.#<p>A few questions about you and your h: Alcune domande su di te e sul tuo nucleo familiare. Ci aiutano a capire quanto è facile per persone diverse muoversi e raggiungere i luoghi di cui hanno bisogno.
it.#Homemaker: Persona che si occupa della casa
it.#Caring full-time for a family member: Mi occupo a tempo pieno di una persona della mia famiglia
it.#Business owner or entrepreneur: Ho un'impresa o un'attività in proprio
it.#Work through an app or platform (e.g. d: Lavoro tramite app o piattaforma (es. rider per consegne, autista NCC tramite app)
it.#Unemployed looking for work: Senza lavoro, in cerca di occupazione
it.#Unemployed not looking for work: Senza lavoro, non in cerca di occupazione
it.#Not working for health reasons: Non lavoro per motivi di salute
it.#Do you have flexible working hours (the: Hai un orario di lavoro flessibile, cioè puoi scegliere o modificare l’orario di inizio e fine?
it.#Thinking about the income of everyone w: Pensando al reddito di tutte le persone che vivono con te, quale di queste descrive meglio la situazione economica del tuo nucleo familiare?
it.#We struggle to cover basic needs: Abbiamo difficoltà a coprire le necessità di base
it.#We can cover basic needs: Riusciamo a coprire le necessità di base
it.#We can cover basic needs comfortably an: Riusciamo a coprire comodamente le necessità di base e ci rimane una piccola somma
it.#We can afford most things we want with: Possiamo permetterci la maggior parte delle cose che desideriamo e occasionalmente alcune spese extra
it.#We are financially very comfortable and: Siamo in una situazione economica molto agiata e possiamo permetterci facilmente spese extra
it.#Do you have a disability, health condit: Hai una disabilità, una condizione di salute o una limitazione, anche lieve, che rende più difficili i tuoi spostamenti?
it.#For example with walking, sight, hearin: Per esempio nel camminare, nella vista, nell'udito, nell'attenzione o per un dolore, oppure se usi una sedia a rotelle o un altro ausilio. Lo chiediamo per capire quali ostacoli incontrano le persone.
it.#In which neighbourhood or area of Munic: In quale quartiere o zona del Municipio XII vivi attualmente?
it.#If you use another name (e.g. Gianicole: Se usi un altro nome (es. Gianicolense o Portuense), scegli il quartiere ufficiale più vicino o Altro.
it.#Do you currently work remotely (partly: Attualmente lavori da remoto, parzialmente o completamente?
it.#Yes (3 days or more in a week): Sì (3 o più giorni alla settimana)

fr.#Welcome to Your Profile: Bienvenue dans le questionnaire sur votre profil
fr.#<p>A few questions about you, your hous:
Quelques questions sur vous, votre foyer et l’endroit où vous habitez.

La participation est volontaire et vous pouvez passer n’importe quelle question, par exemple celle sur le revenu. Vos réponses ne sont pas associées à votre nom. Indiquer votre adresse e-mail est facultatif ; les informations sur la protection des données de SmartUrbanity expliquent comment elle est protégée et comment vos réponses sont utilisées.

En savoir plus sur SmartUrbanity
fr.#<p>Your submission has been recorded. T: Votre réponse a bien été enregistrée. Merci d’avoir pris le temps de remplir ce questionnaire.
fr.#If there is a car in your household, ho: S’il y a une voiture dans votre foyer, dans quelle mesure vous est-il facile de l’utiliser quand vous en avez besoin ?
fr.#What is your highest completed level of: Quel est le plus haut niveau d’études que vous avez terminé ?
fr.#If you are still studying, choose the l: Si vous faites encore des études, indiquez le dernier niveau terminé. Si vous avez étudié à l’étranger, choisissez l’équivalent le plus proche.
fr.#Upper secondary school (high school dip: Second cycle du secondaire (diplôme de fin d’études secondaires)
fr.#Which of the following best describes y: Laquelle de ces situations décrit le mieux votre lien avec le Municipio XII ?
fr.#I live here (even without official regi: J’habite ici (même sans résidence officiellement déclarée)
fr.#I travel here regularly for work or stu: Je viens ici régulièrement pour travailler ou étudier
fr.#I come here regularly for services, hea: Je viens ici régulièrement pour des services, des soins de santé ou pour accompagner quelqu’un
fr.#I come here now and then (e.g. to study: Je viens ici de temps en temps (p. ex. pour étudier, travailler ou voir des gens)
fr.#I'm visiting or staying for a short tim: Je suis ici en visite ou pour un court séjour (p. ex. tourisme, famille)
fr.#How strongly do you feel connected to t: Quelle est la force du lien que vous ressentez avec les personnes de votre quartier ?
fr.#Neither connected nor disconnected: Un lien ni fort ni faible
fr.#How many adults (aged 18 or older), inc: Combien de personnes adultes (de 18 ans ou plus), y compris vous, vivent dans votre logement ?
fr.#How many children (aged under 18) live: Combien d’enfants (de moins de 18 ans) vivent dans votre logement ?
fr.#Do you regularly accompany or look afte: Accompagnez-vous ou aidez-vous régulièrement une personne qui a besoin de votre aide pour se déplacer ou dans la vie quotidienne ? Vous pouvez choisir plusieurs réponses.
fr.#Yes, I accompany children or teenagers: Oui, j’accompagne des enfants ou des jeunes presque tous les jours (par ex. à l’école, au sport ou à d’autres activités)
Oui, j’accompagne des enfants ou des jeunes au moins une fois par semaine
fr.#Yes, I help an adult who lives with me: Oui, j’aide une personne adulte qui vit avec moi (par ex. une personne âgée de ma famille ou une personne en situation de handicap)
fr.#Yes, I help an adult who does not live: Oui, j’aide une personne adulte qui ne vit pas avec moi
fr.#Which of the following vehicles are ava: Lesquels des véhicules suivants sont disponibles dans votre foyer ?
fr.#Powered wheelchair or mobility scooter: Fauteuil roulant électrique ou scooter de mobilité
fr.#Do you hold a valid driving license? (C: Avez-vous un permis de conduire valide ? (Voiture, moto ou les deux)
fr.#Yes, but I do not drive: Oui, mais je ne conduis pas
fr.#Which of these best describe your curre: Laquelle de ces situations décrit le mieux votre activité professionnelle ou vos études actuelles ? Si vous étudiez et travaillez, vous pouvez choisir deux réponses.
fr.#Self-employed or freelance (full-time): Travail indépendant ou en freelance (temps plein)
fr.#Self-employed or freelance (part-time): Travail indépendant ou en freelance (temps partiel)
fr.#<p>A few questions about you and your h: Quelques questions sur vous et votre foyer. Elles nous aident à comprendre dans quelle mesure il est facile, pour différentes personnes, de se déplacer et de rejoindre les lieux dont elles ont besoin.
fr.#Caring full-time for a family member: Soins à temps plein à une personne de la famille
fr.#Work through an app or platform (e.g. d: Travail via une application ou une plateforme (par ex. livraisons à domicile, transport de personnes en VTC)
fr.#Unemployed looking for work: Sans emploi et à la recherche d’un emploi
fr.#Unemployed not looking for work: Sans emploi et ne recherchant pas d’emploi
fr.#Not working for health reasons: Sans activité professionnelle pour raison de santé
fr.#Do you have flexible working hours (the: Avez-vous des horaires de travail flexibles, c’est-à-dire pouvez-vous choisir ou modifier vos heures de début et de fin ?
fr.#Somewhat (within a 1-2 hour window): En partie (avec une marge de 1 à 2 heures)
fr.#Thinking about the income of everyone w: En pensant aux revenus de toutes les personnes qui vivent avec vous, laquelle de ces propositions décrit le mieux la situation économique de votre foyer ?
fr.#We struggle to cover basic needs: Nous avons du mal à couvrir nos besoins essentiels
fr.#We can cover basic needs: Nous pouvons couvrir nos besoins essentiels
fr.#We can cover basic needs comfortably an: Nous couvrons facilement nos besoins essentiels, mais il nous reste peu d’argent
fr.#We can afford most things we want with: Nous pouvons nous permettre la plupart des choses que nous souhaitons, avec quelques dépenses supplémentaires occasionnelles
fr.#We are financially very comfortable and: Nous sommes très à l’aise financièrement et pouvons facilement faire face à des dépenses supplémentaires
fr.#Do you have a disability, health condit: Avez-vous un handicap, un problème de santé ou une limitation, même légère, qui rend vos déplacements plus difficiles ?
fr.#For example with walking, sight, hearin: Par exemple pour marcher, voir, entendre, vous concentrer, à cause d’une douleur, ou si vous utilisez un fauteuil roulant ou une autre aide. Nous posons cette question pour comprendre les obstacles que rencontrent les personnes.
fr.#In which neighbourhood or area of Munic: Dans quel quartier ou quelle zone du Municipio XII habitez-vous actuellement ?
fr.#If you use another name (e.g. Gianicole: Si vous utilisez un autre nom (par ex. Gianicolense ou Portuense), choisissez le quartier officiel le plus proche, ou Autre.
fr.#Do you currently work remotely (partly: Travaillez-vous actuellement à distance, en partie ou entièrement ?
fr.#Yes (3 days or more in a week): Oui (3 jours ou plus par semaine)
fr.#Yes, occasionally (1-2 days in a week): Oui, occasionnellement (1 à 2 jours par semaine)
fr.#Person with a speech bubble: Personne avec une bulle de dialogue

de.#Welcome to Your Profile: Willkommen zum Fragebogen zu Ihrem Profil
de.#<p>A few questions about you, your hous:
Einige Fragen zu Ihrer Person, Ihrem Haushalt und dem Ort, an dem Sie wohnen.

Die Teilnahme ist freiwillig und Sie können jede Frage überspringen, zum Beispiel die zum Einkommen. Ihre Antworten werden nicht mit Ihrem Namen verknüpft. Die Angabe Ihrer E-Mail-Adresse ist freiwillig; die Datenschutzhinweise von SmartUrbanity erklären, wie sie geschützt wird und wie Ihre Antworten verwendet werden.

Mehr über SmartUrbanity erfahren
de.#<p>Your submission has been recorded. T: Ihre Antwort wurde gespeichert. Vielen Dank, dass Sie sich Zeit für diesen Fragebogen genommen haben.
de.#If there is a car in your household, ho: Falls es in Ihrem Haushalt ein Auto gibt: Wie leicht können Sie es nutzen, wenn Sie es brauchen?
de.#What is your highest completed level of: Welches ist Ihr höchster erworbener Bildungsabschluss?
de.#If you are still studying, choose the l: Wenn Sie noch in Schule, Studium oder Ausbildung sind, wählen Sie den zuletzt erworbenen Abschluss. Wenn Sie im Ausland gelernt oder studiert haben, wählen Sie den am ehesten vergleichbaren Abschluss.
de.#Which of the following best describes y: Welche der folgenden Aussagen beschreibt Ihre Beziehung zum Municipio XII am besten?
de.#I live here (even without official regi: Ich wohne hier (auch ohne offiziell gemeldeten Wohnsitz)
de.#I travel here regularly for work or stu: Ich komme regelmäßig zum Arbeiten oder Studieren hierher
de.#I come here regularly for services, hea: Ich komme regelmäßig hierher, um Dienstleistungen oder medizinische Versorgung zu nutzen oder um jemanden zu begleiten
de.#I come here now and then (e.g. to study: Ich komme ab und zu hierher (z. B. zum Lernen, Arbeiten oder um Leute zu treffen)
de.#I'm visiting or staying for a short tim: Ich bin zu Besuch oder nur kurz hier (z. B. Urlaub, Familie)
de.#How strongly do you feel connected to t: Wie stark fühlen Sie sich mit den Menschen in Ihrem Viertel verbunden?
de.#How many adults (aged 18 or older), inc: Wie viele Erwachsene (ab 18 Jahren), Sie selbst eingeschlossen, leben in Ihrem Haushalt?
de.#How many children (aged under 18) live: Wie viele Kinder (unter 18 Jahren) leben in Ihrem Haushalt?
de.#Do you regularly accompany or look afte: Begleiten oder unterstützen Sie regelmäßig eine Person, die Ihre Hilfe braucht, um unterwegs zu sein oder den Alltag zu bewältigen? Sie können mehrere Antworten auswählen.
de.#Yes, I accompany children or teenagers: Ja, ich begleite fast täglich Kinder oder Jugendliche (z. B. zur Schule, zum Sport oder zu anderen Aktivitäten)
Ja, ich begleite mindestens einmal pro Woche Kinder oder Jugendliche
de.#Yes, I help an adult who lives with me: Ja, ich helfe einer erwachsenen Person, die mit mir zusammenlebt (z. B. einer älteren Person aus der Familie oder einer Person mit Behinderung)
de.#Yes, I help an adult who does not live: Ja, ich helfe einer erwachsenen Person, die nicht mit mir zusammenlebt
de.#Which of the following vehicles are ava: Welche der folgenden Fahrzeuge stehen Ihrem Haushalt zur Verfügung?
de.#Do you hold a valid driving license? (C: Haben Sie einen gültigen Führerschein? (Auto, Motorrad oder beides)
de.#Yes, but I do not drive: Ja, aber ich fahre nicht selbst
de.#Which of these best describe your curre: Welche dieser Angaben beschreibt Ihre aktuelle Arbeits- oder Ausbildungssituation am besten? Wenn Sie sowohl lernen oder studieren als auch arbeiten, können Sie zwei Antworten auswählen.
de.#<p>A few questions about you and your h: Einige Fragen zu Ihrer Person und Ihrem Haushalt. Sie helfen uns zu verstehen, wie leicht es für verschiedene Menschen ist, unterwegs zu sein und die Orte zu erreichen, die sie brauchen.
de.#Caring full-time for a family member: Pflege oder Betreuung eines Familienmitglieds in Vollzeit
de.#Work through an app or platform (e.g. d: Arbeit über eine App oder Plattform (z. B. Essenslieferungen, Fahrdienste über eine App)
de.#Do you have flexible working hours (the: Haben Sie flexible Arbeitszeiten, also können Sie Beginn und Ende Ihrer Arbeitszeit selbst wählen oder anpassen?
de.#Thinking about the income of everyone w: Wenn Sie an das Einkommen aller Personen denken, die mit Ihnen zusammenleben: Welche dieser Aussagen beschreibt die wirtschaftliche Situation Ihres Haushalts am besten?
de.#We struggle to cover basic needs: Wir haben Schwierigkeiten, unsere grundlegenden Bedürfnisse zu bezahlen
de.#We can cover basic needs: Wir können unsere grundlegenden Bedürfnisse bezahlen
de.#We can cover basic needs comfortably an: Wir können unsere grundlegenden Bedürfnisse gut bezahlen, aber es bleibt nur wenig Geld übrig
de.#We can afford most things we want with: Wir können uns die meisten Dinge leisten, die wir möchten, und gelegentliche zusätzliche Ausgaben tragen
de.#We are financially very comfortable and: Wir sind finanziell sehr gut aufgestellt und können zusätzliche Ausgaben problemlos tragen
de.#Do you have a disability, health condit: Haben Sie eine Behinderung, eine gesundheitliche Beeinträchtigung oder Einschränkung, auch eine leichte, die Ihnen das Unterwegssein erschwert?
de.#For example with walking, sight, hearin: Zum Beispiel beim Gehen, Sehen, Hören, bei der Aufmerksamkeit oder durch Schmerzen, oder wenn Sie einen Rollstuhl oder ein anderes Hilfsmittel nutzen. Wir fragen, um zu verstehen, auf welche Hindernisse Menschen stoßen.
de.#In which neighbourhood or area of Munic: In welchem Viertel oder Gebiet des Municipio XII wohnen Sie derzeit?
de.#If you use another name (e.g. Gianicole: Wenn Sie einen anderen Namen verwenden (z. B. Gianicolense oder Portuense), wählen Sie das nächstgelegene offizielle Viertel oder Sonstiges.
de.#Difficult (often unavailable or shared): Schwierig (oft nicht verfügbar oder wird geteilt)
de.#Do you currently work remotely (partly: Arbeiten Sie derzeit teilweise oder vollständig von zu Hause oder einem anderen Ort aus?
de.#Yes (3 days or more in a week): Ja (3 Tage oder mehr pro Woche)

tr.#<p>A few questions about you, your hous:
Siz, haneniz ve yaşadığınız yer hakkında birkaç soru.

Katılım gönüllüdür ve gelir gibi istediğiniz soruyu atlayabilirsiniz. Yanıtlarınız adınızla ilişkilendirilmez. E-posta adresi vermek isteğe bağlıdır; SmartUrbanity gizlilik bildirimi bunun nasıl korunduğunu ve yanıtların nasıl kullanıldığını açıklar.

SmartUrbanity hakkında daha fazla bilgi edinin
tr.#<p>Your submission has been recorded. T: Yanıtınız kaydedildi. Bu anketi doldurmak için zaman ayırdığınız için teşekkür ederiz.
tr.#If there is a car in your household, ho: Hanenizde bir otomobil varsa, ihtiyaç duyduğunuzda onu kullanmanız ne kadar kolay?
tr.#What is your highest completed level of: Tamamladığınız en yüksek eğitim düzeyi nedir?
tr.#If you are still studying, choose the l: Hâlâ öğrenim görüyorsanız tamamladığınız son düzeyi seçin. Yurt dışında okuduysanız en yakın karşılığını seçin.
tr.#Which of the following best describes y: Aşağıdakilerden hangisi Municipio XII ile ilişkinizi en iyi tanımlar?
tr.#I live here (even without official regi: Burada yaşıyorum (resmi olarak kayıtlı ikametim olmasa bile)
tr.#I travel here regularly for work or stu: İş veya eğitim için buraya düzenli olarak geliyorum
tr.#I come here regularly for services, hea: Hizmetler, sağlık hizmetleri veya birine eşlik etmek için buraya düzenli olarak geliyorum
tr.#I come here now and then (e.g. to study: Buraya ara sıra geliyorum (örn. okumak, çalışmak veya insanlarla görüşmek için)
tr.#I'm visiting or staying for a short tim: Ziyaret için veya kısa süreliğine buradayım (örn. turizm, aile)
tr.#How strongly do you feel connected to t: Mahallenizdeki insanlara kendinizi ne kadar bağlı hissediyorsunuz?
tr.#Neither connected nor disconnected: Ne bağlı ne de kopuk hissediyorum
tr.#How many adults (aged 18 or older), inc: Siz dahil, evinizde kaç yetişkin (18 yaş ve üzeri) yaşıyor?
tr.#How many children (aged under 18) live: Evinizde kaç çocuk (18 yaş altı) yaşıyor?
tr.#Do you regularly accompany or look afte: Ulaşımda veya günlük yaşamda yardımınıza ihtiyaç duyan birine düzenli olarak eşlik ediyor ya da bakıyor musunuz? Birden fazla yanıt seçebilirsiniz.
tr.#Yes, I accompany children or teenagers: Evet, neredeyse her gün çocuklara veya gençlere eşlik ediyorum (ör. okula, spora veya diğer etkinliklere)
Evet, en az haftada bir kez çocuklara veya gençlere eşlik ediyorum
tr.#Yes, I help an adult who lives with me: Evet, benimle birlikte yaşayan bir yetişkine yardım ediyorum (ör. yaşlı bir akrabaya veya engelli bir kişiye)
tr.#Yes, I help an adult who does not live: Evet, benimle birlikte yaşamayan bir yetişkine yardım ediyorum
